messages:
Priya CSM: Heads-up from renewal calls today — three patterns repeating across accounts: (1) CSV export schema mismatch (customers expect nested line_items JSON), (2) per-route cost granularity unclear in billing UI, (3) embeddings similarity drops when customer prefix token is injected. Posting examples and quick asks so PM/Eng can triage.

Eli CS Ops: can you paste a sanitized CSV header and a short example of the embedding pair?

Priya CSM: CSV header (sanitized): order_id,customer_id,line_items_json,total_price,redwood_tokens
Customer expects line_items_json as JSON string per row; our flattening causes their ETL join to fail.

Priya CSM: Embedding pair (sanitized):
orig: "customer returns policy summary"
prefixed: "ACME_CORP: customer returns policy summary"
observed sim(q8)=0.63 expected >0.9 (reported on dedicated pool emb-large-q8)

Sam (PM): flagging BeaconCare as at-risk renewal — they reported 40% ETL failures because of the CSV shape. Propose: P0 one-off export + migration guide; P1 UI copy tweak for per-route billing; P1 embeddings probe. Agree?

Noah (Eng): I'll take embeddings. I need the small repro set and to know runtime variant (q8 or fp16). If q8 shows regression we can add a temporary routing rule to avoid q8 for accounts that inject prefixes. Also can produce the one-off export if dataset id and retention window provided.

Eli CS Ops: counts this week: 5 accounts export mismatch, 9 asked about cost visibility, 3 embeddings reports. BeaconCare gave dataset ID BC-2025 and okayed manual export.

notify-bot: Triage card created: CS-EXPORT-5023. Meeting scheduled: 2025-04-10 11:00 PT. Invite sent.

Priya CSM: Action items before triage: Eli 1 collect raw BeaconCare header + dataset id (done), Noah 1 reproduce embedding pair on q8 vs fp16 and share harness command, Sam 1 draft migration guide snippet and include jq example. Goal: ship one-off export within 48h and have a triage decision for routing change within 1 week. :white_check_mark:
